subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets check-mode automation ignore lower-severity secrets-audit findings?
rationale: The implementation is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether info-level secrets findings may be ignored by automation is a security/product policy choice.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR for now and invite a maintainer/secops owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the audit policy is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the opt-in public CLI contract because the default remains `info` and the PR includes docs, tests, CI, and redacted terminal proof.

options.title: Request narrower policy
options.body: Ask for a narrower owner-approved variant, such as limiting the threshold to specific finding classes or moving the policy into broader audit/doctor design.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this contributor PR for now and invite a maintainer/secops owner to reopen or sponsor the threshold if the audit policy is accepted.
